emptyBody: Then keep asking for changes, like in a chat. You can attach your own images as references.
placeholderEdit: What should change in the image? (e.g. “make it night”, “add our logo from the attached image”)
refsHint: Up to {{max}} images per request, including the image being edited. PNG, JPEG or WEBP.
tooManyRefs: You can attach up to {{max}} images per request.
noClips: There are no ready clips yet. Create clips first, then come back to add the image.
placedNote: Added. Export the clip again to see the image in the video (the thumbnail is used right away).
thumbHint: Becomes the clip's cover image, cropped to the clip's shape. It's sent with the post on platforms that accept a thumbnail.
deleteBody: The conversation is deleted. The images it created stay in the gallery and in any clip they were added to.
